claim: The average ticket has been above $1,000 in every month since January 2025, including $1,614.45 in January 2026.

bundle.metric_definition: average_ticket = sum(amount) / count(rows) over rows with account = 'revenue' dated within the period (one row = one order)
bundle.notes: Export range: 2026-01-01 to 2026-01-31. General-ledger export from the ERP.
